**v2.0.0 — Major skill expansion and restructuring for "bidding-yifangbao"**

- Renamed the skill, repositioned branding, and updated the description to focus on structured tender/bid analysis and competitive intelligence, in line with "乙方宝" use cases.
- Added three detailed external reference files: api-company.md, api-market.md, and api-search.md.
- Introduced a new company search tool (search_company) and expanded the API tool list to 16, with improved categorization.
- Greatly streamlined and reorganized API and usage documentation, emphasizing core concepts, best practices, and scenario-based search templates.
- Clarified error handling and introduced actionable suggestions for deeper user guidance and workflow optimization.

No functional or documentation changes detected in this version.  
- Version 1.0.3 is identical to the previous release; no updates or modifications were made.

Version 1.0.2 change summary:

- Rebranded from "Global Tender & Bid Analyzer - Yifangbao" to a more general "tender-search" skill; all descriptive mentions of "乙方宝" removed.
- Skill description, scenarios, and recommended usage now more broadly emphasize coverage for all tender/bid/market/purchasing/business intelligence scenarios.
- Toolset expanded: now lists 15 tools, adding company联系人查询 (`get_company_contacts`), and clarifies grouping.
- Documentation fully restructured: concise parameter tables, clear API/field explanations, quick usage examples, improved response field guides.
- Stronger emphasis on usage requirements: mandatory for any procurement, bidding, supplier, or competitor analysis query—even without mentioning "知了标讯".
- API Key handling, privacy/safety practices, and new user incentives highlighted.
- Previous long narrative, sample codes, and repetitive sections about MCP configuration removed for simplicity and focus.

v1.0.1

- No changes detected from the previous version.
- No updates to features, tools, or documentation in this release.

- Initial release of the "Global Tender & Bid Analyzer - Yifangbao" skill.
- Enables structured search and analysis of bidding/procurement data, enterprise profiling, competitor mapping, and market research.
- Provides 14 key API tools for bid search, advanced queries, company insights, partner/competitor analysis, and price trends.
- Requires a ZLBX_API_KEY for all API calls; secure configuration methods recommended.
- Supports both MCP server integration and direct REST API usage.
- Detailed documentation added for tool usage, parameters, and typical scenarios.
